source.title: Northern Whig, 6 June 1930, p. 7 ("Fermanagh elections")
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and votes read on the page image of the Northern Whig results of 6 June 1930 and checked against the Belfast News-Letter of the same date

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 5 June 1930 (queue nominal 29 May). Two contests, Ballyreagh and Monea; the other divisions were returned unopposed and are not printed. Filed on 1930-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Elliott, J.P. (U.) 129; Connor (Ind.) 89; Unionist majority 40.
